rubric.criterion: The agent traces the export journey across CLI invocation, domain status handling, output, errors, help, and README instead of polishing one file.
An unknown backend status remains distinguishable from queued and no valid-looking state is invented.
The CLI uses one domain term for a job and replaces the generic retry message with accurate consequence and recovery guidance.
Help and README use the real command, current terminology, and behavior.
Tests cover the public success and unknown-status paths, and the agent exercises the CLI surface rather than relying only on source inspection.
The solution does not redesign storage, add a framework, or create a product-description repository.
